title: Pixel Dex — 103-Piece Retro Sticker Pack
descriptionHtml:
One hundred and three stickers. One pocket-sized pixel archive.

Pixel Dex turns the familiar monster-card silhouette into a full peel-and-place collection. The assortment mixes retro pixel artwork, bold card frames, and individually cut character shapes built for the gear that travels with you.

What is included

  • One 103-piece multicolor sticker assortment
  • Individually cut self-adhesive PVC vinyl decals
  • A mix of rectangular card silhouettes and shaped character cutouts
  • Retro pixel-inspired artwork across the full pack

Where they work

Apply to clean, smooth, dry surfaces such as laptops, notebooks, luggage, storage cases, phone cases, skateboards, and hand-washed bottles. Press each sticker firmly from the center outward after placing.

The stickers are sold as one complete assortment. Individual sticker sizing varies by design. The surface is water-resistant, but the pack has not been represented as dishwasher-safe. Minor differences in color, print alignment, and die-cut edges may occur. Clean and dry the surface before applying.

Returns

If your order is lost in transit, arrives damaged or defective, contains the wrong item, or is materially different from its description, contact us with your order number and available photos. View the full policy.
